summary: Preserve source, owned, unknown, superseded, failed, and generated artifacts through recoverable quarantine rather than hard deletion.
enforcement: Hard deletion is forbidden. Before removal from an active location, resolve the exact bounded target, record its path and SHA-256 inventory, move it to a recoverable quarantine, verify the post-move inventory, emit a recovery receipt, and retain it for human review. Intake sources may move only after explicit closure and two matching full-tree snapshots followed by an immediate equality check. Abort on drift.
